- Normalizes `at` with `ensure_utc`.
- Rounds amounts via `round_money`; rejects non-positive amounts with `BillingError("negative_amount", ...)`.
- Only allows `captured` payments (`invalid_state` otherwise).
- Prevents cumulative refunds from exceeding the captured amount (`refund_exceeds_captured`).
- Updates `payment.refunded_amount`, sets status to `"refunded"` on full refund, records an audit event, and returns the payment.

All 10 tests pass, plus additional edge-case checks.
